name: Ezra Apple
headline: Software Engineer | AI Product & Agent Infrastructure

education.degree: B.S. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

highlights: Built and launched storefront creation and editing workflows for Replo’s customer-facing AI website builder, including Component Library, reusable templates, and live page previews.
Designed persistent user and project memory for Replo Agent, combining scoped context, automatic curation, and on-demand retrieval to retain knowledge across sessions.
Led consolidation of Replo’s internal agent skills and development workflows, making engineering, design, and support knowledge discoverable and reusable across coding agents.
Improved preview and publishing reliability for Replo’s AI website builder, building automatic preview recovery, asset-readiness checks, and observability for diagnosing customer failures.
Co-founded AI video translation startup, accepted into UC Berkeley SkyDeck Pad-13 incubator program.
Owned end-to-end MVP for AI-driven video translation across 25+ languages, spanning authentication, media upload, processing orchestration, and launch site.
Architected a serverless media-processing pipeline on AWS (S3, Lambda, Step Functions, SES) with fault-tolerant retries for long-running translation jobs.
Ran closed beta with 10+ content creators, translating feedback into product refinements and go-to-market validation.
Applied random forests and Bayesian optimization to ion-source diagnostic data, modeling accelerator performance and exploring configurations to maximize ion output.
Presented findings to senior researchers supporting heavy-element synthesis research, including the element 120 program.

projects.name: ShoutOut
highlights: Built and shipped a local-first macOS dictation product in Swift with global Fn/Globe capture, AVAudioEngine recording, focused-app paste, and WPM/latency stats.
Designed a low-friction interaction model with hold-to-record, double-tap hands-free mode, menu bar controls, recording overlay feedback, and first-run permission onboarding.
Implemented swappable on-device transcription engines using Apple Speech, Apple Dictation, and WhisperKit/Core ML, with dictionary-aware cleanup and spoken-punctuation formatting.
Owned signed app distribution with public website, notarized DMGs, Sparkle updates, GitHub Actions artifacts, and user-local installation into ~/Applications.

emphasis: internal agent skills and development workflows
